card.name: Careful attention and strict technique
card.fires_on: The word "attention" (also "strict") after careful, close or with, when the text asks for care or close observation. It comes before "to" or a technique term such as aseptic.

modes.label: attention
modes.description: The word attention after careful, close or with, followed by what must be watched.
modes.example: requires careful<< attention>> to safety guidelines

modes.label: strict
modes.description: The word strict before aseptic technique in preparation instructions.
modes.example: should be performed with<< strict>> aseptic techniques

card.writes: It pushes toward words like details and detail, so the text goes on to say what needs close care.
card.plain: It marks phrases that ask for close care, such as "careful attention to" or "strict aseptic technique".
